summary.text: Sue Scherer is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 96, in office since 2013, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A teacher by profession, she chairs the Elementary & Secondary Education: Administration, Licensing & Charter School Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sue Scherer earned a B.S. from Illinois State University and an M.S. from Eastern Illinois University, and her professional experience includes working as a teacher.
Scherer assumed office in the Illinois House in 2013 and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Elementary & Secondary Education: Administration, Licensing & Charter School Committee, vice-chair of the International Relations, Tourism, and Trade Committee, and a member of the Museum, Arts, Culture, and Entertainment Committee.
